source.method: Per-room source declaration metadata only; no ROM or compressed map bytes copied.

limitations: These are factual metadata declarations from the pinned public source tree; they are not byte-for-byte verified against the user's private ROM.
BG/clipdata RLE payloads are not present in the public source tree inspected. Only their C declarations, dimensions and array lengths were extracted.

The actual compressed clipdata maps, pixel/block collision placement, BG map contents, enemy coordinates as a playable layout, event scripts and ROM pointer offsets remain pending exact-ROM extraction.
The metadata and source file blob IDs are retained for provenance; no ROM, RLE map bytes, graphics, music or source C files were copied into the project.
